recap: Day 1 (June 25, 2026) introduced Safeeely - an AI-escrow bot for DM deals (social media sales, freelance gigs, crypto) used via Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/Instagram/Apple bots under a 'safetag' handle. Days 1-13 covered early money bugs, a WhatsApp notification chase, a huge solo admin-dashboard build, a full admin design/Realtime consolidation, a 44-field settings rebuild that mostly didn't save at first, an analytics page rebuild, badge cards shipping (and breaking, and getting fixed) across all six bots, and a five-leak memory hunt on the API server. Day 13 (July 1, 2026) closed the badge saga with a WhatsApp-specific image URL/format fix. Day 14 (also July 1, 2026) closed out the memory-hardening pass: three more leak sources patched (a Chrome-crash deadlock in the receipt/PDF generator, a fire-and-forget closure holding full dispute data for 90s, an unbounded broadcast array), then a deep review turned up six correctness bugs in the same code - most notably a race condition where a retried AI dispute resolution could re-run and issue a duplicate refund/commission/badge, and a silent case where a commission wasn't being paid out at all. Next chapter continues into July with the rollout of in-house support ticketing across all six bots.
